s00017.summary: Gloria shouts a tradition greeting from the balloon while nervous Winnie clings to the rope.
Gloria mutters about the dial, fakes a camera, and tells Winnie to hold the burner.

s01056.summary: Duchess convenes the crew in the carousel pavilion and Slim lays out the heist.
Duchess assigns roles, joking about permits and Pearl's cut.
Bones notes a sixth share in the ledger; Lavalle admits he withheld the truth.

s01073.summary: Rival lawyers Nadia and Eli spar over a ledger missing from the inventory.
The Judge appears and demands to know why a sealed ledger sits on a dock.
Eli lunges for the ledger, boxes topple, and Deputy Hale bursts in.
The Judge stands down the deputy and takes the ledger to chambers.

pd_sisters_0.summary: Olga recalls their father's death a year ago on a bright noon.
Olga complains of exhaustion; she and Irina long for Moscow while the men laugh.
Irina glows with name-day joy; Olga muses she would like a husband.
Tuzenbach announces Vershinin's visit and describes him, while Soleni and Chebutikin wander in.

s01054.summary: A wary woman locks herself in the motel room and checks every corner.
She tests her recorder and logs day one; playback adds a whispered line.
A key tag reveals she is repeating a borrowed identity as Lena Marsh.
The recorder starts itself, speaks of the future; she smashes it and hides as the bathroom stirs.

pd_earnest_3.summary: Chasuble, Miss Prism and Cecily leave the two brothers together.
Jack orders Algernon out; Merriman's unpacked luggage forces Jack to arrange his departure.
Algernon and Jack trade barbs over mourning clothes and the four-five train.
Algernon, alone, praises Cecily, then tells her he is being sent away.

s01116.summary: At a wine tasting, Camila teases ex Teddy about his sour-faced verdict.
Henrik praises the wine; Izabella introduces him to Teddy as her fiance.
Teddy congratulates them, drains his glass, and Camila tenderly refills it.

s01093.summary: Mr. Abernathy instructs Peggy to start the film at eight and leaves.
Tucker gives Peggy an envelope: she won the scholarship.
Tucker says Dad already read it and put it back; Peggy tears up.
Peggy starts the projector and asks for the next reel; their fingers brush.

s01076.summary: Marguerite offers Thaddeus a pointless promotion as Chief Pod Officer.
Thaddeus condemns the layoffs and the Farewell Sync invite for his mentor's funeral.
He admits cheerfully training people marked for layoff, then quits.
He slaps his name tag on the table and rejects the budget.

pd_sisters_3.summary: Anfisa happily describes her new government flat while Vershinin checks his watch.
Vershinin and Olga say farewell, trading regrets and philosophy while waiting for Masha.
Masha arrives; Olga steps aside as she and Vershinin say a final good-bye.

s01034.summary: Beatrix and Nico note the fox missing an eye and question Fenwick's claim.
Beatrix finds a note in the socket as Fenwick edges away; it points to the owl.

pd_sisters_1.summary: Andrey dismisses a visitor and retires; a nurse sings to the child.
Vershinin and Masha talk of civilians and army men; he confesses his unhappy home.
Vershinin kisses her hand and declares love; Masha laughs, afraid, then hides her face.
Irina and Tuzenbach enter, he declaring he will escort her home for years.

pd_earnest_0.summary: Algernon and Lane banter over piano, sandwiches, champagne and marriage.
Jack arrives as Ernest; Algernon grills him about the country, noticing the tea.

s01038.summary: Kwan questions Eloise at a deposition in a funeral home about the will witness.
Brandao finds the damaging statement; Eloise asks for water, steadying her shaking glove.

s00005.summary: Sabine lays out the casino vault plan timings to her crew.
The gray man gives his name as the funicular nears the summit.

s01075.summary: Isolde and Morvan trade threats across the silver bridge.
Despite news the east wall fell, Isolde draws her sword and stays to fight.
She charges across the swaying bridge, deflects his spear, and presses the attack.

s01098.summary: At the wake, Delphine, Rosemary and Benedict squabble over the will.
Silence falls; Benedict touches Rosemary's arm and they laugh through grief.
Oswald announces they are ready; Delphine joins them in a row facing the casket.

s01020.summary: Okonkwo surveys the bowling-alley evidence annex and questions the staff about unsigned boxes.
Officer Tran reports a Lennox in the gate log; Lennox emerges from hiding.
Bashir says box nineteen was cut by a razor; Okonkwo waits Lennox out.

s00008.summary: June fends off guard Wallace's questions while secretly relaying to her crew.
Wallace recalls his late wife and Orion; June laughs genuinely.
Wallace reveals he knows about the heist, pours her coffee, and asks them to spare the telescope.

s01101.summary: The crew struggles to wake the dead console; Imani notes the hull is making noise.
A rhythmic tapping is identified as a countdown pattern.
Comms say they are locked in the sub bay, so the tapping source is something else.
The light dies and thin laughter comes from the vent.

s01086.summary: The crowd waits silent at the league finals as Annika needs a final spare.
Annika's first ball leaves one pin wobbling and standing; Hank gloats and taunts.
Muriel calms Annika and Deshawn hands her a towel.
Annika's gentle second throw topples the last pin and the alley erupts.
Hank graciously shakes her hand across the rail and promises a rematch.

s00001.summary: Detective Odalys enters a taxidermy workshop at night to question a woman.
Odalys probes the museum break-in and the woman gives her name, Ingrid.
A museum key tag gives Ingrid away; Odalys reaches for her weapon and orders the needle down.

pd_sisters_4.summary: Trofimov arrives early; Lubov embraces him and weeps for her drowned son.
Lubov notes how he has aged and he accepts being an eternal student.
Pischin begs 240 roubles; Lubov has none and sends him to Gaev.
Alone with Varya and Yasha, Gaev snipes at Lubov's spending and Yasha's smell.
